reason: I do one big hypermarket shop a week with a list in my head, and I have no habit of scanning receipts. The free tier would be enough if I tried it at all, so I would not pay for Plus.
objection: Scanning every receipt is extra work, and I do not believe it will read my Arabic hypermarket receipts correctly. I also doubt the recipes will be what we really cook, even though it says half are Arab.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it read a real Carrefour or Lulu Arabic receipt correctly, plus a Ramadan or iftar meal planner with dishes we actually cook.
